subject: Re: Kickoff: Ledge interpretable-commands evaluation
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and constraints:

- Tereza Aliyev 50% (tech lead), Kaia Wolde 30% on the command-extraction analysis, Chiara Olsen 30% on packaging, Quentin Farkas 20% floating for eval support.
- Compute is trivial — this runs on a workstation; the demo literally ends with inspecting /tmp/refit.png. No cluster ask.

The real constraint is data. Our three internal target functions come out of Corpus, and Jun Varga's Corpus v2 migration freeze lands 2026-07-10, so every target-function dataset we need has to be re-ingested and validated before that date; I've set our internal cutoff at July 3. Chiara will file the ingestion tickets this week so we're not queuing behind everyone else in late June.

Ivo
